text:
# 主题地图如何让内容发布更稳定、更容易扩展

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2026-03-05 23:19（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/2029577448736665846
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29

## 中文全文

每个 SEO 从业者都在谈主题地图，但大多数人并不知道怎么做。

它的不同之处在于，你不再随意发布内容，而是围绕一个核心主题组织内容，以建立我们所说的“主题权威性”。

区别在于，你不再发布东一篇西一篇的文章；主题地图帮助你把每一篇内容放进清晰的主题结构里。

这很棒，因为文章会通过内部链接相互支持，Google 也会把你的网站视为这个主题的权威。

在 AI 出现之前，这些工作都是手工完成的。以前，在写下第一行文字之前，我就要花 3-5 天制作主题地图。

现在有了 AI，事情变得非常容易，我几分钟就能完成。

🔌 我有一套用 AI 做这件事的方法，就在我的个人资料里。

我总是谈这件事，是因为这些年来，我的大多数旅行指南即使没有做什么维护，也一直保持着 SEO 排名。

图片里，一个是我去年做过的项目，另一个则已经好几年没有动过了。

我很少在其他项目里见到这样的情况……

没有理由不做。

它让发布内容变得更容易、更好，而且可以规模化。

即使你不想扩大规模，它也能让你几乎确定：你的内容有 90% 的概率在 SEO 中奏效，并因此在 AI 提及中起作用。

## 英文原文

Every SEO talks about Topical Maps but most people don't know how to do them.

What's different about it is that you don't publish randomly, but you organize your content around a central topic to build what we call "topical authority".

The difference is that instead of publishing random articles, a topical map helps you put every piece of content fits into a clear thematic structure.

This is very cool because the articles support each other through internal links, and Google sees your site as an authority on the topic.

Before AI this used to be done by hand. It took me 3-5 days to make them before even starting to write the first line.

Now with AI is super easy, I do it in MINUTES now.

🔌I have an AI way to do it —in my profile—.

The reason I always talk about this stuff, is because most of my travel guides have maintained their SEO rankings over the years, despite me doing nothing about it.

In the image a project I've worked on last year, and another one that hasn't been touched in the last couple of years.

I rarely see these kind of on other projects...

It doesn't make sense to NOT do it.

Makes publishing easier, better, and SCALABLE.

And if you don't want to scale, it also gives you almost certainty that your content will, with a 90% probablity, WORK in SEO and as a consequence in the AI mentions.
